props.text: This published screen is a synthetic connectivity check. It has no equipment connections, scripts, credentials, database, or process commands.

LOCAL MANAGEMENT
On the gateway computer, use the loopback management address for initial administrator setup and recovery. The installer keeps it separate from network HTTPS.

OPERATOR ACCESS
Open the published project on another computer using the gateway's DNS hostname or IPv4 address and HTTPS port. The certificate must match that name or IP and be trusted.
I checked the DNS or IP identity, certificate trust, HTTPS address and published project

The checkbox is a local browser value only. Seeing this page does not verify equipment safety, certificate renewal, remote write permissions or production readiness. Follow the Network access workshop guide.
